comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. The flat-pack generator (mitcad#1939): a box 200 x 120 x 80 turned into six 6 mm plates with finger joints of about 15 at every edge, on a nested cut sheet. The plates fill the box's shell, 200 120 80 - 188 108 68 = 539328, less the clearance of every finger: the edges along x have 13 fingers over 188 (12 boundaries each), along y 7 over 108 (6), along z 5 over 68 (4): 4 (12 + 6 + 4) = 88 gaps of 0.1 6 6 = 316.8, so 539011.2. The block is removed; the plates are FlatPack1's bodies F2.b0 to F2.b5.
The Flat Pack edited to 4 mm sheet: its six plates made again (the cut sheet keeps its parts, the same bodies).
